share.sms_queued: SMS to {{phone}} is on its way

collect.title: Collect payment
collect.exceeds_due: This is more than the due ({{amount}}). Only cash can be more — the rest is change.

cancel.title: Cancel bill {{number}}?
cancel.description: Bill value {{amount}}. This cannot be undone.
cancel.effect_books: The sale, GST and accounts entries are reversed.
cancel.effect_payments: Payments of {{amount}} are cancelled — hand the money back to the customer.
cancel.effect_loyalty: Loyalty points of this bill are reversed.
cancel.effect_khata: The due is removed from the customer's khata.
cancel.effect_number: The bill number stays in the books as cancelled (GST rule).

convert.title: Convert {{number}} into a bill
convert.description: Choose how to make the bill.
convert.mode_draft_hint: Recall it at the billing counter to change items, take payment and print.
convert.mode_cash_hint: The bill is numbered now; stock and accounts are updated.
convert.mode_credit_hint: The full amount goes to the customer's khata.
convert.mode_credit_unavailable: Needs a customer on the estimate and permission to sell on credit.
convert.cash_hint: If prices changed, any extra stays as change or due.
convert.keep_prices_on: The bill uses the prices quoted in the estimate.
convert.done_draft: Draft bill made — recall it at the billing counter

returns.title: Sales returns
returns.description: Credit notes for goods returned, damaged or expired — with how the money went back.
returns.search_placeholder: Credit note no., bill no., customer or mobile
returns.empty_description: When a customer brings goods back, start from their bill: pick the items, and the credit note and refund are worked out for you.

return_new.title: New return
return_new.description_find: Find the bill the goods were sold on.
return_new.description_lines: Choose what came back and how the customer gets the money.
return_new.find_hint: Type or scan the number printed on the bill.
return_new.no_recent: No bills in the last 30 days
return_new.no_match_hint: Check the number on the bill, or search by the customer.
return_new.not_returnable_hint: Only completed bills can take returns. This bill is {{status}}.
return_new.no_restock_hint: Damaged and expired goods are not put back on sale by default.
return_new.all_returned: Everything on this bill is already returned
return_new.all_returned_hint: Cancel a credit note first if a return was entered by mistake.
return_new.restock_on: Back on the shelf for sale
return_new.settlement: How does the customer get the money?
return_new.settlement_hint: Only the choices allowed for this bill are shown.
return_new.refund_capped: A refund can be at most {{amount}} — what the customer actually paid on this bill.
return_new.walk_in_hint: Store credit needs a customer on the bill.
return_new.pick_lines: Choose at least one item and its quantity.
return_new.no_settlement: No refund mode fits this return.

settlement_help.cash: Hand {{amount}} in cash back to the customer now.
settlement_help.upi: Send {{amount}} back by UPI and note the UTR.
settlement_help.bank_transfer: Transfer {{amount}} to the customer's bank account.
settlement_help.adjust_due: Reduce the bill's due ({{due}}) by {{amount}}. No money changes hands.
settlement_help.adjust_due_excess: Clears the bill's due of {{due}}; the extra {{excess}} stays as the customer's advance.
settlement_help.store_credit: Keep {{amount}} as credit in the customer's account for future bills.
